name: db-rebuildable-projection
body:
The DB stays a rebuildable projection. Correctness must never depend on a fresh `apg/.trans/db.lbug`: the next scan can rebuild it from the code, and the durable layers tree can be re-ingested into it. Mutations that do not strictly need the DB must not open it, and must not contend on it.

Code-FQN (`implemented-by`) validation with no projection. `apg.layers.validate_change` runs the `implemented-by` drift check only when `apg/.trans/graph.jsonl` exists (src/layers.rs:1872-1881); `db.lbug` is never opened for validation. The decoupled path makes this rule explicit and total:
- `apg/.trans/graph.jsonl` is the SOLE code-identity source: `apg.artifacts.code_universes_from_export` reads the real code FQNs from the export and the planned FQNs from the plan store (`Record::PlannedNode`), so when the export is present the `implemented-by` target is resolved against real ∪ planned and rejected when it is neither. A present `db.lbug` without the export is NOT resolved against the DB: the freshness gate (`apg.git.is_stale` / `apg.git.refusal_message`) treats it as stale and REFUSES the mutation with "graph is stale — run `apg scan` before mutating" before any code-ref evaluation.
- NEITHER `db.lbug` NOR `graph.jsonl` nor any index exists (both artifacts gone, or outside a git repo): code-FQN `implemented-by` references are NOT validated and the mutation is accepted with the FQN recorded. This is deliberate, not silently weaker: structural references (edge endpoints, `attaches-to`, contains/depends-on acyclicity, pairing) are ALWAYS validated from the node files, and code identity is a derived-artifact concern — absence of every projection is a valid state, never a failure, and never blocks a durable write. The recorded FQN is re-validated on the next scan, which is authoritative for code identity and surfaces any drift. A present `db.lbug` never reaches this path.

Acceptance: a node/edge mutation path that performs its structural (always) and code-FQN (when the `graph.jsonl` export is present) reference validation without an exclusive/read-write DB open (or that provably does not contend), plus a mutation-level test showing a mutation is correct with both projection artifacts absent — the code FQN is recorded unvalidated and a later scan surfaces any drift.
